programme.title: 火辣辣
programme.desc: 火辣辣是由多位人氣男星（家發方偉傑包勳平Teddy）聯手主持的無厘頭高能量美食外景節目主持群將化身尋辣特派員，跨越 8 個國家與地區，深入當地的菜市場節慶與傳統廚房從挑戰世界第一辣的卡羅萊納死神椒，到品嚐將辣椒融入甜點的奇特飲食文化，他們不僅要探尋辣椒背後的種植與製作祕密，更要親自參與各地的吃辣大賽，挑戰人體味覺的極限！究竟他們能順利問鼎辣椒王的寶座，還是會被辣到俯首稱臣？

programme.title: 巷里巷味第1季
programme.desc: 在街巷之間，人群匯聚，最真實的生活畫面也在此緩緩展開隨著晝夜交替，人來人往，吃作為生活的基本需求，自然孕育出許多經典受歡迎，且可繁可簡的菜餚與小吃沿著食物的脈絡，串起的是一個個鮮活的人物，他們的故事帶著鮮明的時代色彩人與食物相互交織，形塑了街巷的氣質，也描繪出一幅幅充滿煙火氣息的街巷圖景

programme.title: 人生一串第1季
programme.desc: 少了點煙火氣，人生就像是一場孤獨的旅程從雲南昭通一口一串的牛肉小串塔克拉瑪干沙漠裡用紅柳枝串起的霸氣烤羊肉，再到廣西百色讓人既害怕又想試的炭烤豬眼睛夜市與街角邊的燒烤攤遍佈各地，每一攤都有自己獨門的在地風味節目用鏡頭穿梭在街頭巷尾，記錄下最平民的在地美食與夜市傳奇，以最貼近生活的視角，真實呈現那一串串燒烤背後的人情味與故事在享受每一串燒烤帶來的極致美味時，也帶大家一起品味最真實最接地氣的人生滋味

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-絕海的偵探
programme.desc: 緊急接近下！這艘船可能被放置了爆破物京都舞鶴港灣的晨曦，出現了一艘身分不明的船隻，遺留在船上的檔案及物品經查發現全部皆非來自日本國內此一新聞的報導，讓日本全國陷入恐慌柯南小蘭毛利小五郎以及少年偵探團等人，一同參加了神盾艦的體驗航海活動，在日本海上自衛隊員的示範下，親眼見識到氣勢非凡的空中對戰演習這時候，神祕的敵軍突然來襲，演習旋即變成了真實的激烈對戰!小蘭與少年偵探團成員看到眼前的這一切，感到十分恐懼與不安在海上自衛隊冷靜的應對處理下，戰況總算平息了下來，但是卻摸不清敵人的目的為何在此同時，艦裏發現了一隻自衛隊員的左手殘肢，那隻手上戴了一隻時間停滯在上午5時30分的手錶在如此不尋常的事態下，大阪府警方與京都府警方也緊急出動直升機前來現場，協力展開調查而實際上並未登艦的女性自衛官藤井七海，也在此時謎樣般的現身

programme.title: 角頭-浪流連
programme.desc: 故事描述阿慶（鄭人碩 飾演）在北館角頭大哥 仁哥的女兒滿月宴上，偶遇攝影師小淇（謝欣穎 飾演）進而衍生出一段相愛卻不能相守的愛情故事 身為角頭的阿慶遇到了小淇，原本水火不容的兩人，再一次次的爭吵中發現其實自己最在乎對方阿慶與小淇相愛相知相惜互相扶持，阿慶為小淇解決困難小淇在阿慶事業遇到瓶頸時給予鼓勵但就在此時湳沆的世界在背地裡陷害北館販毒，不僅讓北館深陷危機，仁哥與五虎們相繼誤解阿慶，小淇也因為阿慶受重傷阿慶分身乏術，痛定思痛決定奮力一搏

programme.title: 驚天大營救
programme.desc: 親眼目睹妻兒遇害的白安決心復仇，他孤身混入黑幫暗中調查，才發現妻子意外得知黑幫犯罪的關鍵而慘遭毒手，種種線索不僅暗示這背後有著巨大陰謀，更指向商業大賈賀英豪沒想到賀英豪突然失蹤，賀英豪之女賀婷更決定與一心殺父的白安結盟，各懷鬼胎的兩人要在黑警毒梟的追捕下殺出重圍，找出賀英豪

programme.title: 偉大的隱藏者
programme.desc: 元流煥（金秀賢飾）接受潛行任務，潛入南韓京畿道富川的月亮村，裝成傻子除了元流煥，還有國家高層幹部的兒子李海浪（朴基雄飾），他必須成為南韓的歌手，以及偽裝成高中生的間諜李海真（李玹雨飾），與當地村民打成一片，聽候組織下一步的差遣，指派任務 元流煥願意成為間諜最大原因除了是對祖國的忠誠，也是為了守護身在祖國自己母親的安全長時間在南韓的生活，以及受到善良熱心鄰居的影響，讓他逐漸對自己的信念產生質疑

programme.title: 十面埋伏
programme.desc: 時值大唐盛世，在斑斕絢麗的牡丹坊內，一位眉清目秀體態俏麗的歌舞伎伴隨著東方樂音翩翩起舞，宛如躍出壁畫的敦煌飛天仙女，散發最誘人的姿色，讓人很難相信她雙眼失明 她是飛刀門幫主之女（章子怡 飾演），委身在舞館賣藝，不懂武功的她仍盼望有朝一日，能為滅門血案和慘死的父親報仇 為了追查飛刀門餘孽的下落，金捕頭（金城武 飾演）和劉捕頭（劉德華 飾演）來到了牡丹坊，正欣賞著盲眼歌舞伎精彩絕倫的表演突然之間，她一劍刺向劉捕頭！劉捕頭巧妙躲過這一擊，迅速將這位小妹拿下 月黑風高之夜，身手矯健的黑衣人救出了她在逃亡途中，黑衣人不知不覺地愛上了小妹令人吃驚的是，這個黑衣人竟然是金捕頭金捕頭萬萬沒有想到，小妹另有難以告白的隱情，而接下來他所經歷的一切，也都讓他匪夷所思 逃過了層層埋伏和處處追殺，他倆來到一片花海，在漫天遍野的花海中，金捕頭面對妖艷的小妹，兩人情不自禁地共墜愛河正當

programme.title: 錦衣衛-修羅戰場
programme.desc: 明朝天啟七年，北鎮撫司錦衣衛沈煉（張震 飾）在一次掃除亂黨任務中，為救畫師北齋（楊冪 飾），失手將同僚淩雲鎧（武強 飾）殺害此後便將自己陷入無盡深淵，一方面要應付來自陸文昭（張譯 飾）裴綸（雷佳音 飾）輪番質疑與調查，另一方面還被神秘女子要脅要放火燒了錦衣衛經歷司，並助她暗中挖掘醜陋的真相

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-絕海的偵探
programme.desc: 緊急接近下！這艘船可能被放置了爆破物京都舞鶴港灣的晨曦，出現了一艘身分不明的船隻，遺留在船上的檔案及物品經查發現全部皆非來自日本國內此一新聞的報導，讓日本全國陷入恐慌柯南小蘭毛利小五郎以及少年偵探團等人，一同參加了神盾艦的體驗航海活動，在日本海上自衛隊員的示範下，親眼見識到氣勢非凡的空中對戰演習這時候，神祕的敵軍突然來襲，演習旋即變成了真實的激烈對戰!小蘭與少年偵探團成員看到眼前的這一切，感到十分恐懼與不安在海上自衛隊冷靜的應對處理下，戰況總算平息了下來，但是卻摸不清敵人的目的為何在此同時，艦裏發現了一隻自衛隊員的左手殘肢，那隻手上戴了一隻時間停滯在上午5時30分的手錶在如此不尋常的事態下，大阪府警方與京都府警方也緊急出動直升機前來現場，協力展開調查而實際上並未登艦的女性自衛官藤井七海，也在此時謎樣般的現身

programme.title: 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: 混沌之初天界頹垣，在神族與魔族大戰之中，女媧娘娘張梓琳飾化成萬千五彩晶石補天，其中一顆掉落凡間花果山，晶石吸收天地精華迸出了石頭靈猴他跟菩提祖師海一天飾習得法術取名孫悟空甄子丹飾 ，並在花果山自封為齊天大聖，但他不知天高地厚地大鬧東海龍宮闖進南天門，卻意外獲得玉皇大帝周潤發飾賞識賜爵弼馬溫

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅一夜變調，現今的他窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助多年未見的女兒小寶和她的律師男友乃華與此同時，老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片在網路瘋傳，讓他獲得了拍電影的機會

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之怒海雄風
programme.desc: 甲午戰敗，喪權辱國的馬關條約簽訂後，日本又想武力強佔東沙群島，進而吞併西沙群島南沙群島軍機大臣張之洞堅決主戰，並前往廣州整軍備戰於是以服部一郎川島雪姬為首的日本殺手秘密組織神奈社，買通白蓮教，抓走張之洞大人黃飛鴻和他的徒弟們以身犯險查詢線索開始了營救張之洞之路，慢慢揭開了日本人的陰謀

programme.title: 生死危機
programme.desc: 前特警教官張智勇（趙文卓 飾）因故過失殺人入獄在他即將被押送回國服刑的當天，妻子楊曼（趙子琪 飾）為了讓丈夫在萬呎高空見家人一面，帶著孩子搭乘了同一班機沒想到班機竟遭到國際恐怖份子劫持，張智勇在制伏歹徒後，更發現機上被裝了三顆定時炸彈，其中一顆甚至緊綁在妻子身上在孤立無援的機艙內，他必須與時間賽跑，拆解危機

programme.title: 21世紀命案:3

programme.title: 偵訊實境第2季:12

programme.title: 儲物狂第15季:5

programme.title: 21世紀命案:8
programme.desc: 一名 19 歲少女無故失蹤，警方苦尋線索卻一無所獲；隨著調查深入，一則網上貼文逐步揭露背後的致命真相

programme.title: 被告者-有罪或無罪？第4季:2
programme.desc: 出外旅遊的護理師在新墨西哥州因交通違規而將車子停在路邊，卻因在家鄉俄亥俄州犯下加重強盜罪而被逮捕她是真的罪犯或有明確的不在場證明

programme.title: 儲物狂第15季:6

programme.title: 與殺手共眠第2季:19
programme.desc: 一名事業有成的年輕律師，看似完美的人生因一段秘密婚外情而崩塌；妒火引發的對峙，最終在愛達荷州一個寧靜小鎮釀成命案

programme.title: 攝影機下的臥底現場:1
programme.desc: 臥底NYPD警察和ATF特殊探員親身學到了別信任嫌犯的表面功夫，無論看起來多麼友好，都不可相信

programme.title: 奧札克執法實錄第1季:1
programme.desc: 警官凱爾基吉（Kale Keagy）攔查到一名疑似酒駕駕駛，對方卻提出了一個出乎意料的要求在鎮上的主要大街上，警官安潔爾麥考密克（Angel Macormic）則正面對一名違法停在身障車位上的駕駛

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:153
programme.desc: 孩子在法庭上要與殺了父親的母親斷絕關係；與青少年學生發生關係的教師向受害者的家人道歉等

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:154
programme.desc: 極其憤怒的原告在虛擬聽證會上暴怒，遭控藐視法庭；兇手四人組在宣佈判決時，失控地啜泣；法官對被告人的抱怨忍不住大笑

programme.title: 阿拉斯加州警第9季:1
programme.desc: 在阿拉斯加的夏至期間，阿拉斯加州警追捕一名逃跑嫌犯化解一起持槍對峙事件，並調查發生在北極圈附近的縱火案件

programme.title: 殺手調查第1季:4
programme.desc: 香蒂庫珀-特隆尼斯（Shanti Cooper-Tronnes）在她的家被選中參加翻修節目前一週被發現死亡她的丈夫聲稱這是一場意外，但偵探們揭露了一個謊言和欺騙的故事

programme.title: 被告-是我所為？:1
programme.desc: 一名男子在與一名深夜從佛羅里達酒店下班返家的年輕母親正面相撞後，當場死亡檢方指控該女子受酒精或藥物影響，導致車禍發生

programme.title: 被告-是我所為？:2

programme.title: 衝鋒警犬第1季:10
programme.desc: 衝鋒警犬帶領觀眾深入第一線執法現場，透過監視器警員密錄器警車行車紀錄器無人機等多元視角，真實呈現警官與警犬搭檔在高風險勤務中並肩作戰的驚險瞬間由演員暨資深警犬倡議者吉姆貝魯西擔任主持人，再次走進他最熟悉的警犬世界這一次，沒有劇本沒有演出，只有最真實的執法現場捕捉警犬與領犬員之間無可取代的默契，見證牠們憑藉敏銳本能精準判斷與無畏勇氣，成為執法人員最可靠最忠誠的夥伴

programme.title: 偵訊現場:2
programme.desc: 嫌犯在偵訊室失去冷靜；比起答案，槍傷驚人的男子留給警方更多疑問；捉迷藏遊戲變得致命等

programme.title: 黃金48小時後第15季:97
programme.desc: 黃金48小時後完整呈現最精彩的案件故事，透過與關鍵參與者的獨家訪談，包括警探受害者家屬甚至是犯人等，針對這些刑案調查呈現從犯罪逮補到審判以及後續情況的完整故事了解兇殺案對於每個相關人士所造成的持久影響

programme.title: 美墨獵逃:10
programme.desc: 每年，有超過一千名被通緝的美國人逃往墨西哥，隱藏起來，開始新的生活，並認為自己已經逃脫了然而，這些逃犯不知道的是，墨西哥有一支精英警察部隊，其唯一任務就是抓捕國際逃犯，其中90是美國人在這個系列中，我們將與這支團隊一起行動，調查追蹤並捕捉美國逃犯，然後將他們移交給美國的執法機構，讓他們面對正義

programme.title: 出庭作證第4季:7
programme.desc: 出庭作證 第4季講述了一個犯罪故事，但與眾不同之處在於，它是從被告親自上證人席獨特視角出發，讓觀眾能夠透過被告本人的眼睛去理解整個事件的發展與真相節目由丹艾布拉姆斯（Dan Abrams）主持，每一集都會完整呈現案件的各個層面，從被告的第一手證詞，到與檢方激烈交鋒的交叉詰問，再到最終的判決結果，環環相扣，層層推進節目強調，站上證人席為自己辯護，是一種極具風險的選擇，且極少有被告會願意親自出庭作證這樣的決定往往像是一場賭注，稍有不慎，可能改變整個判決的方向

programme.title: 21世紀命案:10
programme.desc: 21世紀命案使用100真實案件，讓觀眾身歷其境，呈現重要犯罪故事本節目使用真實調查材料個人相片社群媒體貼文文字訊息電子郵件和其他數位足跡，展開最近最令人震驚的罪行，也就是那些只有使用21世紀的科技才能破解的罪行

programme.title: 她她她的少女時代:1
programme.desc: 人到中年，營役半生，方迎風的人生卻迎來遽變！失婚失業，女兒離巢，她迷失她頑抗，卻體力衰退與社會脫節身為別人的女兒老婆老媽，她卻忘了少女時代，也曾是個熱血勇悍瘋狂追星的搖滾樂迷！二十年前的輕狂歲月，二十年後的柴米油鹽，面目全非的她，竟重遇當年迷戀的偶像！偶像潦倒不堪，丈夫欲斷難斷，種種挫折與衝擊，迫使她直面過去的失敗，重新振作，激勵自己與身邊人唱著一首首動人歌曲，一群失意的中年男女，再次出發，為了自己，再活一次！

programme.title: 戇夫成龍:19
programme.desc: 事情緣起於傻仔丁常旺，旺本是豪門富商包慶豐九代單傳的獨子，旺母本是包老爺的妾侍，因原配夫人妒忌，誣捏旺母與家樸有染，包老爺盛怒之下，視有了身孕的旺母是懷有孽種，把旺母逐出家門，旺母流落異鄉並誕下旺，兩母子過了二十幾年相依為命的艱苦生活而包老爺二十多年來仍無子嗣，直至原配夫人患病去迦後，包老爺有感膝下無子承繼家產，遂派親侄包大業往尋旺兩母子，知不尋獲，包老爺寧願臨老續娶求子，也不會把家業傳給親侄大業一直欲承繼包老爺家產，如今希望幻滅，遂起歪心，在尋到旺兩母子時，暗中加害之，旺母死，旺被打傷後腦滾下山崖業以為旺已死，即找來一個身份卑賤的孤兒，頂包假冒包老爺之子，改名為包繼宗大業並編造故事，令繼宗亦以為自己就是流落在外的包家少爺

programme.desc: 孫堅和妻子李慧蘭在小滿胡同生活了幾十年，他們有兩個如花似玉的女兒，大女兒孫心在飛蜚網絡做程序員，為人穩重大方，工作勤勤懇懇，認真負責，深得上司和同事們的好評，她即將升任開發組組長二女兒孫想生性活潑開朗，酷愛研究美食，在一家大型超市旁邊的奶茶店上班，業餘時間用手機記錄自己研發的甜品，深受顧客的歡迎，她的公眾號裡也有了很多粉絲，由於她的手機很舊，拍攝的圖像很模糊，孫想想攢點錢買一個新手機

programme.title: The Mummy ((木乃伊))
programme.desc: Adventurer Rick OConnell travels to Hamunaptra, the city of the dead, with an archaeologist and her brother. There they accidentally awaken Imhotep, a high priest from the reign of the pharaoh Seti I, who has been cursed for eternity. (冒险家里克·奥康奈尔与一位考古学家和她的兄弟前往哈穆纳普特拉,这是死者的城市.)

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor ((木乃伊3：龙帝之墓))
programme.desc: Rick and Evelyn have retired to England, and their now-grown son is following in their footsteps. But its the resurrection of Chinas ten-thousand-strong terracotta army that brings the adventuring couple back into the action. (里克和埃文琳已经退休到英国,他们的成长的儿子也跟随了他们的脚步.)

programme.title: The Mummy ((木乃伊))
programme.desc: 2,000 years ago in Egypt, Princess Ahmanet was buried alive in a tomb beneath the desert as punishment for killing her father. The ancient princess is awakened in the modern era when her tomb is rediscovered. Holding a malevolent grudge that has grown over millennia, once resurrected she begins spreading terrors on earth that defy human comprehension. (两千年前,阿曼尼特公主在埃及被活埋在沙漠下一个坟墓里,作为惩罚,因为她杀死了父亲.当她墓被重新发现时,古代公主在现代时代醒来.)

programme.desc: Airel enggan menerima kehamilan Damia dan meragui status anak itu, menyebabkan konflik mereka semakin memuncak. Dalam masa sama, Sara dan Irfan semakin bahagia, malah Irfan membantu merapatkan hubungan Sara dengan Hussin. Namun, ketika mereka kembali menikmati kebahagiaan, Irfan dikejutkan dengan berita mengejutkan daripada Tokma mengenai Fatimah yang selama ini berkelakuan pelik.

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn Abdullah menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Celebs Day Off
programme.desc: Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda juga akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan episod kali ini, Mekyun.

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan Eglaf dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Koleksi Pakcik Lego dan Bedah Kotak Mythos - Embroidered Floral Shirt

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Andy Teh, Syafiq, Hans Yusoff dan Yonnyboii.

programme.title: Misteri Mona Ku Serumu Kembali
programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Hilang Kasyorga EP6
programme.desc: Madam Kwan teringat kembali kisah sebenar. Vince, anaknya, ialah pedofil yang menculik Kasyorga dan Hamdi. Uncle Lim

programme.title: Bonnie
programme.desc: Bonnie, seorang remaja sekolah menengah, mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam. Walau bagaimanapun, berbekalkan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri, dia mampu bertahan untuk melindungi dirinya malah orang-orangnya.

programme.title: Siccin 7
programme.desc: Terpaksa meninggalkan kerjayanya sebagai doktor dan melarikan diri akibat satu perjanjian berdarah dengan sindiket mafia yang mengeksploitasi kanak-kanak pengemis, Kemal berpindah bersama keluarganya ke rumah agam milik bapa saudaranya.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand Dia Perempuan Sialan EP3
programme.desc: Syawal memarahi Riska susulan satu insiden yang melibatkan Nerina tanpa menyedari sifat sebenar Riska. Sementara Afidah berjuang mempertahankan peninggalan mendiang suaminya, kenangan kelam mengenai kekejaman Puan Sri pada masa lalu kembali muncul.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP3
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di Galaeri Perfileman yang ditubuhkan pada 2007 terletak di KL. Asalnya bangunan banglo tersebut adalah sebuah rumah keluarga. Galeri ini menyimpan peralatanperalatan lama perfileman untuk dipamerkan. Pengalaman misteri yang pernah dilalui oleh Encik Muhammad Rosli, penjaga galeri dikongsi bersama, beliau pernah beberapa kali terjumpa dengan lembaga wanita berambut panjang, pergerakan perkakasan dan bunyi yang menakutkan. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan, mereka berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi yang hampir sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP6

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP9
programme.desc: Zacky selamat setelah dirawat oleh Dr Zakir dan Dr Flora. Sementara itu Alia mula terganggu dengan Zacky dan orang-orang yang memanggil namanya Affi. Ritz masih tetap merahsiakan idenditi Alia kerana bimbang dia disakiti. Alia mula meragui idenditinya lalu bertindak untuk menyiasat. Dalam situasi berasingan, sepasukan polis giat menyiasat kes-kes lama berkaitan kehilangan dan kematian wanita yang tidak dapat dikesan. Amir menjadi suspek utama mereka

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5 ((阿爷厨房 Sr.5))
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps ((璀璨之城))
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Big Feast Duel ((美食強人))
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. programme.title: Mean Talk

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes ((破毒强人))
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT ((未来警察))
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates. (与女神交配的真人秀《与女神的约会》又回到了一起,第二季的爱情战场也都升级了!金媒人鲍勃·拉姆正在从世界各地招募男人来配对女神何培霞、郭培勉、陈若熙、于克采诚和元甲曼。勇敢的追求者面临着挑战,比如,用他们自己的独特策略来赢得女神。一对一的亲密游戏点燃了燃心的兴奋情绪,一个隐藏的女神加入了这场争斗,进一步加大了等待的火花,勇敢的求婚者们努力到达终点并捕捉女神的心!此外,上个季节的五个女神,以及名人宾,将轮流成为Peanut小组,提供女神约会的现场报道。)

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces. (在时间的流逝和流逝中,描述城市缩影的当地商店越来越少见。然而,它们是城市结构的重要部分,也是香港精神不可替代的体现。铭记这一点,下到土宿主Louis Yuen带领观光员逐商店探索、参观时间充裕的现代商店,横跨日常生活的四个关键领域:服装、食品、住房和交通。他揭示了经营历史的商店、维护历史的困难以及几代人的故事,利用这些有形商店保存无形的记忆并展示小空间的持久美景。)

New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again ((中文))
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts, (你并非孤军奋战的归来者!在第二个赛季,节目再次由鬼王梁西浩王(Ghosts Leung Si Ho)和黄耀英、黄志燕(Wong Yiu Ying Ying)和编辑王志燕(Wong Ying Yeuk)和黄智燕(Tong Chi Yan)共同主持,让观众们更加高兴和惊讶。每集都关注不同的超自然主题,由分享幽灵故事并揭露宗教仪式和行业习俗秘密的重量级客人组成。在充满神秘的世界里,节目汇集了来自全球的超自然新闻,而志燕将前往南韩和台湾探索当地超自然现象。与观众的实时互动也是“精神联系”的亮点,与团队密切跟踪实况广播,)

programme.desc: Show Biz delivers fast-paced coverage of the latest celebrity news, entertainment events and popular culture. Through studio segments, interviews, live reports and highlights, the programme keeps viewers informed about current stars, performances and industry developments.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street ((白日青春))
programme.desc: Hassan is a Pakistani refugee boy whose father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. In the process, the two gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death

programme.title: Someone Like Me (像我这样的人)
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival. (中国移民铁头党在东京和移民同胞一起为生存而奋斗,然后才开始建立新的三合会。 正如他获得合法居留权并决定离开黑社会一样,警察镇压和背叛也迫使他回到一场无情的生存斗争中。)

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot (记住我忘记的)
programme.desc: Struggling with Alzheimers disease, Hong Kong film buff Kim relies on his brother to manage their appliance repair shop. Kims quirky behaviour prompts producer Ginger to suspect that he may be a film critic trying to profit from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger uncovers Kims secrets and sorrows as she gets closer to him and his family. (香港电影院与阿尔茨海默氏病抗争,金正日的金正日依靠他哥哥管理家用电器修理店。 金正日的行为促使金洁生产商怀疑他可能是电影评论家,试图从严厉的评论中获益。 金吉儿作为朋友,当她接近金氏和他的家人时,金吉儿发现了金氏的秘密和悲伤。)

programme.title: A Writers Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Call Me Agent ((我要做特務))
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Untouchable ((不可侵犯))
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake. (菲成为澳门巨人黄的右手,他的手深处涉及合法和非法业务.然而,面临地下暴力,权力斗争和道德困境,菲被爱与正义之间撕裂.很快,他发现自己陷入了致命的博中,他的生命在危险中.)

programme.title: Hell Hole ((地狱洞))
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment. (影片中有三个不同时代的恐怖故事:一个被鬼魂为救婴儿而牺牲生命的孕妇,在被四名医科学生欺负后,一个男孩自杀,他的精神回报是报复,一些公司工作人员打开一盒旧衣服,释放了20多年的怨恨,后来又闹鬼。)

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend (我印度男朋友)
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Soul Mate ((灵魂伴侣))
programme.desc: July and An Sheng have been best friends since they were thirteen. They always believed their friendship would last forever, until they meet Su Jia Ming at the age of eighteen. The trio find themselves in a love triangle, which puts the girls friendship to the test and alters their destinies. (7月和安盛自13岁起就一直是最好的朋友。 他们一直相信友谊将永远持续下去,直到他们18岁时见到苏佳明。 三重奏发现自己身处三角情境,让女孩的友谊接受考验并改变她们的命运。)

programme.title: Endless Battle (无止境的战斗)
programme.desc: This is a story about two brothers. The younger brother is a drug lord while the elder brother Zhong is a police officer in the Narcotics Bureau. Both are involved in a drug cartels turf battle and during an escort mission, Zhong discovers his brothers hidden identity. This leads to an endless battle between good and evil.

programme.title: I Believe ((我仍然相信))
programme.desc: Chu Chu has been waiting for her first love for 10 years but he marries someone else in the end. As she loses faith in love, she meets a wedding planner and a handsome and rich man, who both help her get over her ex-boyfriend. As Chu Chu feels the same love from them, she must make up her mind. Who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Love is the only Answer ((人约离婚后))
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: Operation Mekong ((湄公河行动))
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Band Four (第四乐队)
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music. (在她母亲去世后,一个叫Band Four的独立乐队的一位有抱负的歌手与她离散的吉他手父亲团聚。 与其同父异母的姐姐和9岁的儿子一起,新团聚的家庭聚集在一起,通过对音乐的爱和热情相互支持。)

programme.title: Z Storm ((反贪风暴))
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk is on the case of a corrupt policeman but finds all key witnesses killed when he starts to discover some clues. As investigation continues, Luk uncovers the fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the governments 15 billion Care Fund. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.

programme.title: The Locksmith ((锁匠))
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Rens help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shans wifes disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang. (这是关于香港三合会的故事。 钟·威廉·陈。 张德里克·赞和东·爱德华·楚伊是童年的朋友,他们一起加入三合会。 但是,在加入后,他们发现名声和财富最终将粉碎他们,因为他们中只有一人能够成为黑帮头目。)

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire ((我和僵尸有个约会))
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: The Three Smiles ((三笑))
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends help. (在家里工作,他伪装为仆人.在向她透露自己的真实身份时不相信胡,只有当他透露自己的才能和朋友帮助时才会爱上他.)

programme.title: Police Force ((警察的故事: 我在黑社会的日子))
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: The Female Prince ((这个王妃有点萌))
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan (小巧继母在她未婚夫龙龙拒绝放弃婚约并把他送进监狱时,陷害她未婚夫龙龙,小萧为了救他,伪装成龙龙,参加皇室考试,排第一。小萧受皇帝的压迫,将公主嫁给他。当小萧在新婚之夜洗干净时,她劝公主按照计划行事。)

programme.title: The Thundering Sword ((神剑震江湖))
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon Thundering Sword to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated. (和是两个门徒,他们的主人派他们去追踪无敌的武器雷剑,以防止恶棍获得它.遇到了一个无情的部落的女儿,,她正在寻找剑.他们很快就恋爱了,但当意外伤害时,事情变得复杂.)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1961 ((红楼梦1961))
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: Murder Plot ((高空跳伞谋杀案))
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiance suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiance accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds ((007：金刚钻))
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an ((蒙面大侠))
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor. (汉皇帝死亡,他的皇帝卢夺取统治权力.她阴谋杀死王位继承人恒,但面具战士发现她的阴谋,并提醒.派他的公主去安求助.面具战士在路上保护公主免受攻击者,并支持成为新皇帝.)

programme.title: Moods Of Love ((风花雪月))
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel. (关于一个人会去哪里去爱情或欲望的Song王朝时期的这篇文章有两个故事.第一讲述了一个恶魔般的法官,试图通过雇佣一个漂亮的妓女,诱惑一个佛教僧侣脱离自称独身.第二讲述了一个被剥削的年轻女孩,被迫在一个无私夫妇妓院工作.)

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard ((大刀王五))
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics. (作为一个安全公司的负责人,王会见一位学者,他是改革派的成员,这是一群在清朝末推动中国社会改革的学者.皇帝实际上支持这种改革,但不是女皇.她命令逮捕改革派,王被吸引到政治中.)

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan ((花木兰))
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity. (穆兰伪装为一名男子士兵,以取代她老年父亲在与野蛮人作战时.她的勇气带来了她在战斗中的胜利,她被晋升为将军.当穆兰带着荣耀回家时,总司令要求她嫁给他的女儿,迫使穆兰透露她的真实身份.)

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance ((明月刀雪夜歼仇))
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star ((星际钝胎))
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other. (一个漂亮但无知的女人被外星人绑架,但没有人相信她的近距离遇见. 计划自杀以证明自己,她遇到了一个失败的侦探,他也计划自杀. 他们在发现彼此后改变了他们的想法,开始遇到奇怪的冒险,然后爱上彼此.)

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow ((徐老虎与白寡妇))
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung ((龙虎会风云))
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shihs magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires. (的英雄是银幕原始功夫女士之一,Shih Szu,她扮演剑女孟洪.她必须与洛莱赫饰演的Fan Tien-Fu合作,寻找和保护王朝的皇家.的壮丽表演让她获得了另一个成功的女英雄角色.)

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants ((欢笑老弄堂))
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile ((飞龙斩))
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom? ((女校春色))
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight ((流氓千王))
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off! (杀手明星丹尼·李扮演一个需要成为英雄的男人的主角. 他撒谎,偷窃和欺骗自己运营一个豪华的场,)

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie ((花街时代))
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on. (年轻的梅丽在万市工作为酒吧女生,以谋生.当她在酒吧里遇到吉米时,她认为他是她的真正爱人,并疯狂地爱上他.当吉米必须离开时,梅丽很丧.直到她遇到三人团的老板,她终于找到了一个可以依靠的人.)

programme.title: Swordswomen Three ((江湖三女侠))
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called Swordswomen Two. Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaws first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans. (虎,隐藏龙可以被称为剑女二.三十年前,沈,埃西林奇亚和潘英曾担任了肖的第一名国际超级明星,洛莱赫为汉家族剑 - 这使得这成为动作粉丝的四星级盛宴.)

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister ((乾隆皇君臣斗智))
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperors plot once again. (英明的帝国学士刘勇总是以其敏锐的智慧和格言使忠龙皇帝难堪。 皇帝特意安排他解决看似无法解决的问题。 然而,刘勇以智慧和风格轻而易举地解决问题,再次挫败皇帝的阴谋。)

programme.title: The Priest
programme.desc: Father Carmen investigates mysterious suicides, stumbling upon a disturbing fact with serious consequences.

programme.title: Stalin
programme.desc: Stalin is deeply moved by the suicide of a girl with physical disabilities. As a result, he devises a formula of extending unconditional help to those who need it to establish peace.

programme.title: Taana
programme.desc: In a small village, a man battles family pressure to become a policeman, navigating personal struggles and discovering what truly matters in life.

programme.title: Bhaagamathie
programme.desc: Chanchala Reddy, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

programme.title: Nilavuku En Mel Ennadi Kobam
programme.desc: A heartbroken young man agrees to an arranged marriage chosen by his parents. Just as he accepts this new path, his former love unexpectedly reenters his life, complicating matters.

programme.title: Kozhipannai Chelladurai
programme.desc: Chelladurai and Jeyasudha, siblings, face lifes struggles after a devastating tragedy, their unbreakable bond fortified by their uncle Periyasamys constant guidance since childhood.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Nesam
programme.desc: Nathans loan rejection from a bank leads him to pursue a romantic relationship with the daughter of the bank manager, but his intentions are discovered, resulting in unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Krack
programme.desc: When 3 notorious criminals lock horns with a hot-tempered police officer, Potharaju Shankar, little do they know that they will end up behind bars.

programme.title: Veerame Vaagai Soodum
programme.desc: A normal man from a middle-class family questioning the authorities for abusing their powers.

programme.desc: Karthi is guided by visions of a man on a white horse as he strives to arrange his sisters marriage. However, an ominous prophecy soon unfolds, bringing unexpected troubles his way.

programme.desc: Forest officials in Kotagiri hunt a man-eating tiger that is attacking innocent people. At the same time, a serial killer is on the prowl for wealthy single women.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets ((北极解密))
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets ((北极解密))
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets ((北极解密))
programme.desc: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: 赌城大亨之新哥传奇
programme.desc: 取材自澳门赌王何鸿燊的真人真事，讲述由1930至1960年代赌王努力打拼至事业高峰的故事1941年日本入侵香港，年青大学生贺新逃离香港奔赴澳门贺新起初在码头做苦力，凭着他的胆色过人刻苦耐劳和聪明机智，最终登上澳门博彩业的第一把交椅

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龙星起初为清朝九品候补知县九品芝麻官，号称青天的包拯后裔，却无包拯维护公义的精神，接受地方土豪的贿赂而诬害忠良，以至人人喊打后来痛改前非，为一名含冤被判处死刑的女子申冤，历尽千辛万苦上燕京告御状，最后被封为八府巡按，在公堂辩论打败恶势力，告大白于天下

programme.title: 九龙城寨
programme.desc: 曾是东北街头武霸的阿能为了出人头地，洗心革面来到香港的九龙城寨从零开始打拼，不料却卷入一场黑恶势力间的阴谋和混战最终为保护被黑恶势力追杀的好朋友，阿能重拾自我，挺身而出，与城寨居民一同对抗黑恶势力，誓死保卫朋友

programme.title: 僵尸叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山间，一僧一道比邻而居和尚（午马 饰）随和开朗，更有一女徒菁菁（李丽珍 饰）玲珑可爱；道士（陈友 饰）古板严厉，而徒弟嘉乐（钱嘉乐 饰）却鬼马顽皮性格不同的两个师傅口角不断，大斗其法，两个冤家徒弟也搞笑连连，笑料频出

programme.title: 望夫成龙
programme.desc: 在乡间长大的情侣石金水和吴带娣青梅竹马，但娣父反对他们在一起，于是二人搬到市区共同生活带娣为助金水找到一份推销员工作，暗中当舞小姐为其筹款金水因工作勤奋，受上司赏识，加以提拔虽然工作发展如意，但金水渐渐发觉自己与带娣的距离越来越远...

programme.title: 激战
programme.desc: 曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐随着他悉心训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，两人在挑战极限的过程中共同成长程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，也重新找回了对生命的热情，并学会珍惜生命中真正重要的人

programme.title: 风雨同路
programme.desc: 卧底探员张郎奉命接近前黑帮大哥李云飞，调查冷血匪帮首领大傻所涉及的钻石劫案，并借机套取线报当交易出现意外后，钻石落入李云飞手中，大傻决心将两人置于死地张郎与李云飞被迫联手反击

programme.title: 赌侠
programme.desc: 自赌神高进退隐后，其徒刀仔在赌坛崭露头角然而，盛名之下暗箭难防，各方强敌纷纷觊觎其地位与名号身陷连场赌局与重重阴谋，刀仔凭藉超群胆识与过人智慧见招拆招，最终在这场巅峰较量中，成功捍卫了赌神之名

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 韦小宝被反清复明的天地会被派到皇宫当卧底，受命查探四十二章经下落韦小宝很快成为康熙皇帝的心腹，但他既要执行天地会的任务，最后陷入两难的状态

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿
programme.desc: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活

programme.title: 青木劫
programme.desc: 民国初年，富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门，唯一的目击证人家中的幼女在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪几十年间，位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥着灵异惊悚的气氛随着真相逐渐揭露，这个恐怖的疑团交织着复仇与死亡的动机

programme.title: 男与女
programme.desc: 偷渡客孟思晨匿居于山边木屋区，沦为众男工具，期间结识非法拳师江远生，并发生雾水情缘后来思晨下嫁中年木匠贵叔，生活虽安稳，心灵却空虚意外再遇远生后，难免干柴烈火，未几更有孕...

programme.title: 摩登仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 陈七是职业惯匪，偷呃拐骗无所不为，但从不使用暴力；张曼珠是电视台新晋演员，收入微薄，生活拮据一次偶然中，陈得到了一枚巨钻，欲找买家脱手，却遇杀手追杀，情急下将巨钻藏于某鞋店的一只高跟鞋内，后来，此鞋刚好被张买去参加舞会

programme.title: 雪儿
programme.desc: 舞蹈教师雪儿年轻貌美，被富商戴家乐力追，但她却喜欢青年艺术家阿化，并与他同居戴家乐心有不甘，设计让雪儿对他改观，更利诱阿化离开雪儿！

programme.title: 一个人的武林
programme.desc: 武术教头夏侯武因错手杀人沦为阶下囚，却在狱中敏锐察觉到一场针对全港武林高手的连环杀戮他凭神准预判命案成功赢得女督察陆玄心的信任，破格出狱协助调查与此同时，先天残疾却武痴成狂的封于修四处血腥挑战各路宗师随着杀戮疯狂升级，两位绝世武者终将迎来轰烈对决

programme.title: 女人心
programme.desc: 有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

programme.title: 中华英雄
programme.desc: 1913年，华英雄惨遭灭门，愤然流亡美国妻子洁瑜怀孕寻夫，二人异乡重逢孰料龙凤胎出生当夜，中华楼遭敌纵火，洁瑜惨死女婴被掳十六年后，子华剑雄踏上寻父之路，华英雄则于自由女神像顶，与宿敌无敌展开生死决战

programme.title: 师兄撞鬼
programme.desc: 该片描述董骠调查制造毒品案，却惨死在毒贩枪下董骠化做鬼魂回警察局，借警员周星驰之手查清杀己的凶手冯淬帆和周星驰在茅山老祖的指导下利用灵药合力斗败邪恶法师，枪毙邓公子，为董骠报了仇，使他能安心上天堂

programme.title: 头文字 D
programme.desc: 本片由日本同名殿堂级漫画改编而成故事描述十八岁的拓海，每天驾驶着父亲残旧的汽车送递豆腐，却无意中练得一手出神入化的飘移技术拓海被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟在众人错愕之下胜出，一夜成名，之后更面对一连串惊险绝伦的挑战赛！

programme.title: 西游记大结局之仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 在月光宝盒引发的混乱之后，至尊宝被卷入时空之中，并逐渐觉醒为孙悟空的真实身份在凡人情感与天命之间不断拉扯，他努力在对紫霞仙子的爱情与肩负的使命之间作出艰难抉择

programme.title: 神话
programme.desc: 考古学家杰克因神秘梦境的指引，揭开自己前世身为大将军蒙毅，与异国公主玉漱有一段跨越千年的凄美爱恋当两人在秦始皇陵天宫重逢之际，为夺取长生秘密的财阀尾随而至杰克重拾前世战力，与强敌展开一场跨越千年的宿命对决

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道长与徒弟隐居于偏远村庄某日，玛利亚修女计画重建一座荒废已久的教堂，却意外唤醒沉睡多年的僵尸黑袍传教士全镇顿时陷入恐慌，面对传统茅山术失效的绝境，一眉道长唯有与西方驱魔神父联手，融合中西驱魔之法，展开一场惊心动魄的驱魔大战

programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第1集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第19集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第34集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 第24集
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第2集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第20集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第35集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第8集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第17集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第29集
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第30集
